stop_decision: No replacement campaign or production changes; return qualified evidence for independent and Pro review.

findings.detail: Interaction sentinel lookup hashed the encoded token instead of decoded canonical bytes and compared zero-row hashes. Exact sentinel field preservation is unproven; fixture DBs were already removed.
findings.current_source_fix: Reuse browser.CanonicalTokenDigest; require exactly one row for every sentinel lookup.
findings.validation: Focused normal/race pass; restoring wrong digest via valid Go overlay fails before timing. No replacement primary samples.

findings.detail: Archive checkpoint policy/history was controlled, but the pinned materializer runs one-second SQLite PASSIVE checkpoints without a public Config switch. That background phase was not aligned across seed histories.
findings.scope: Observed wall/process-CPU/WAL deltas include this work; no isolated deletion cost or worker benefit established.
